title: A new view of the Helix Nebula

evidence.locator: 6145 x 6623 px over 27.26 x 29.38 arcmin; Hubble ACS in [O III] 502 nm and H-alpha 658 nm, with the Mosaic II camera of the CTIO 4 m telescope for the rest. The page prints the picture's place on the sky: the frame's centre at 22 29 41.92, -20 50 13.29, north 0.3° left of vertical.
